# Maison Interior Design

> Residential and commercial interior design and build studio in Singapore, founded 2018; its builder team mainly builds landed houses. Managing Director: Roland Ng. WhatsApp/phone +65 9339 1185, email maisoninteriordesignsg@gmail.com.

## Services
- [Residential interior design](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/#residential): HDB flats and condominiums, concept to handover.
- [Commercial interior design](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/#commercial): cafes, restaurants, offices.
- [3D design](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/#3d-design): perspective 3D drawings and colour proposal before work starts.
- [Landed house building](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/landed-homes/): the builder team mainly builds landed houses, with the interior planned by the same team.

## Process
Conceptualisation; itemised quotation with 3D drawings; HDB renovation permit and renovation loan applications; design and build with dedicated project management; 2-year workmanship warranty and post-sales service.

## Suppliers
Maison works with these Singapore suppliers for materials, flooring, lighting and furnishings: [KD Panels](https://www.kdpanels.com/), [Chroma Living](https://chromafurnishing.com/chromaliving), [Hafary](https://www.hafary.com.sg/), [ADOORE](https://adoore.com.sg/), [Wood Origins](https://woodorigins.sg/), [Stones Selection](https://www.stonesselection.com.sg/), [Lambent](https://www.lambent.sg/), [Meerkat Home](https://www.meerkathome.sg/), [RIGEL](https://www.rigel-group.com/).

## Service guides
- [BTO key collection renovation](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/bto-renovation/): Collecting BTO keys soon? What to check in the first 30 days, HDB renovation rules and hours, the 3-year toilet tile rule, and a realistic keys-to-move-in timeline.
- [New condo renovation](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/new-condo-renovation/): Just got keys to a new condo or EC? What owners usually change, a handover defects checklist, how MCST renovation approval works, and a realistic timeline.
- [Landed renovation](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/landed-renovation/): Renovating a terrace, semi-detached, bungalow or strata landed home in Singapore: what the work involves, URA and BCA approvals, MCST rules for strata landed, and timelines.
- [Office fit-out](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/office-fit-out/): Fitting out a new office in Singapore: what the job involves, landlord fit-out rules, when fire safety and building approvals apply, and a realistic timeline to move-in.
- [Retail shop fit-out](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/retail-shop-fit-out/): Fitting out a shop, café or F&B unit in Singapore: what the job involves, landlord and HDB shop rules, food licensing, and a realistic timeline to opening day.
- [Commercial fit-out](https://maisoninteriordesign.sg/services/commercial-fit-out/): Commercial interior design and fit-out in Singapore for offices, shops, cafés and showrooms: how the work runs, the approvals that apply and realistic timelines.
